items.description: There is no versioned specification of the URDF format. The main reference for the URDF format are the ROS wiki docs on URDF.
items.title: URDF

items.description: Libraries to import, export and manipulate URDF files.
items.title: Libraries
iDynTree
items.description: Library for kinematics and dynamics computation of free-floating robot model, with support for import and export of URDF files. It includes Python and MATLAB bindings. [BSD]

items.title: urdfdom
items.description: Reference C++ URDF parser implementation mantained by OpenRobotics. [BSD]

items.title: urdf_parser_py
items.description: Reference Python URDF parser mantained by OpenRobotics. [BSD]

items.title: odio_urdf
items.description: Library for building URDF files using Python. [MIT]

items.title: compas_robots
items.description: URDF parser & writer in Python based on the COMPAS framework. [MIT]

items.title: urdf-viz
items.description: Visualize URDF/XACRO file, URDF Viewer works on Windows/MacOS/Linux. [APACHE2]

items.title: Unity-Technologies/URDF-Importer
items.description: URDF Importer allows you to import a robot defined in URDF format in a Unity scene. [APACHE]

items.title: yourdfpy
items.description: Library and command-line tool to load, visualize, manipulate, validate and save URDF files.

items.title: URDFly
items.description: URDFly is a Python-based toolkit for working with URDF files, providing tools for parsing, visualizing, and analyzing robotic systems defined in URDF format, with a focus on axes visulazation, urdf editing, MDH parameter conversion, kinematics calculation, and dynamics regressor codegen.

items.title: URDFormer
items.description: Given an image, URDFormer predicts its corresponding interactive 'digital twin' in the URDF format.

items.title: bubblify
items.description: Bubblify is an interactive tool for creating spherical approximations of robot geometries directly from Universal Robot Description Format (URDF) specifications

items.title: xacro
items.description: Xacro is an XML macro language. With xacro, you can construct shorter and more readable XML files by using macros that expand to larger XML expressions. Xacro is frequently used to mantain URDF models. [BSD]

items.title: blender-robotics-utils
items.description: Set of utilities for exporting/controlling your robot in Blender. It includes a URDF to Blender model converter. [BSD]

items.title: xacrodoc
items.description: A wrapper around xacro providing friendly interfaces to compile xacro files to plain URDF or MJCF from Python or the command line. No ROS installation is required.

items.title: jupytercad_urdf
items.description: A JupyterLab extension allowing export of CAD designs to URDF.
Several libraries and groups have extended the URDF format beyond the official specs, a brief list is provided in the file.
